data.narrative: Student demonstrated outstanding performance in Module 06, designing and debugging a production-grade Cache-Aside Redis layer for the B2B multi-tenant URL shortener. The student deterministically reproduced the stale cache anomaly where PATCH updates committed to PostgreSQL while Redis continued serving outdated destinations for up to 3600 seconds. The student implemented atomic cache invalidation on link updates and deletions, incorporated strict organization scoping (org_id) into cache payloads to prevent cross-tenant cache eviction attacks, and preserved graceful degradation fallback to PostgreSQL when Redis is unavailable. All 8 checks in verify_module_06_fix.py and 6/6 tests in verify_module_06.py passed with zero regressions.

dimension_scores.observation: Analyzed tradeoffs between Cache-Aside with eviction, Write-Through caching, and short TTLs, correctly choosing Cache-Aside with active eviction to guarantee immediate consistency without slowing down administrative writes.
dimension_scores.evidence: Selected Option B in DECIDE; evaluated risks of stale reads in short-TTL approaches versus complexity of write-through transactions.

dimension_scores.observation: Systematically demonstrated cache staleness using reproduce_module_06_break.py, verifying that PostgreSQL had the new URL while Redis served the old URL, and validating post-fix cache eviction and repopulation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Observed HTTP 307 redirecting to initial URL after PATCH; verified post-fix cache eviction (cached_after_patch is None) and redirect to new destination.

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced multi-tenant isolation in caching by binding org_id to cache payloads and preventing cross-tenant cache eviction or cache poisoning attempts.
dimension_scores.evidence: verify_module_06.py Test 4 confirmed cross-tenant PATCH, DELETE, and cache invalidation were blocked with 404 and warnings logged.

dimension_scores.observation: Engineered robust graceful degradation where Redis connectivity timeouts or failures fall back transparently to PostgreSQL, ensuring redirect uptime is never compromised by cache infrastructure outages.
dimension_scores.evidence: verify_module_06.py Test 5 confirmed 307 redirect succeeded via PostgreSQL query when Redis was simulated offline.

dimension_scores.observation: Authored thorough postmortem analysis and reflection records detailing cache invalidation mechanics, lifecycle events, and production stampede risks.
dimension_scores.evidence: Compiled complete evidence records in progress/evidence/debugging-module-06-*.md with complete test metrics.
